title: De optimo medico cognoscendo (Arabic Fī miḥnat afḍal al-aṭibbāʾ, 'On Examining the Physician'); RU: Гален, «Об испытании (распознавании) лучшего врача»
author: Galen
date: Late 2nd c. CE; Arabic translation from Hunayn's circle, 9th c.
edition: Iskandar, CMG Suppl. Or. IV (Berlin 1988), Arabic + English; free online at cmg.bbaw.de (copyrighted).
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Гален» lists all Russian translations (Терновский 1971, Балалыкин/Щеглов 2014, Пролыгина, Афонасин); none is of an Arabic-only work. Solopova 2018 lists none.
en_evidence: Iskandar 1988 (CMG Suppl. Or. IV), confirmed on the CMG online list.
value: Galen on charlatans, public demonstrations and how to test physicians in Rome; strongly autobiographical. A core source for the social history of Roman medicine.
ai_feasibility: High (Arabic). Iskandar's English is available for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: The Rome anecdotes and test chapters, c. 6k words (estimate).
